_comment: Curated single-person full interactions, hand-picked from the moment library after reading transcripts. Each = ONE person, one street stop, start to finish. moments in story order. Built cut-only (no captions/titles) by scripts/build-full-interactions.mjs.

interactions.name: FI_BAKERY_MAHMOUD
interactions.who: Muslim baker, wouldn't let me pay

interactions.name: FI_AHMADI_MUSLIM
interactions.who: Ahmadi Muslim: 'love for all, hatred for none'

interactions.name: FI_IQAM_PEACE
interactions.who: Iqam near the mosque: peace through dialogue

interactions.name: FI_AMERICAN_MUSLIM
interactions.who: American Muslim tourist: 'I just landed and saw Muslims everywhere'

interactions.name: FI_BELARUS_TOURIST
interactions.who: Belarus tourist: 'people here are nice even though I'm not Jewish'

interactions.name: FI_BEACH_GUY
interactions.who: 'What's your favorite part about Israel?' — the beach

interactions.name: FI_BERLIN_SUPPORT
interactions.who: Tourists from Berlin: 'why do you support Israel' — for humanity

interactions.name: FI_JAFFA_MUSLIM
interactions.who: Muslim from Jaffa — long conversation

interactions.name: FI_NIGERIA_WORK
interactions.who: From Nigeria, came to Israel for work

interactions.name: FI_CHRISTIAN_RESTAURANT
interactions.who: Christian restaurant owner: free food, kosher meat, 60 years, grew up with wars

interactions.name: FI_CROSS_CHRISTIAN
interactions.who: 'I saw your cross' — friends Jewish and Muslim, we're all human

interactions.name: FI_INDONESIAN_INSTAGRAM
interactions.who: Indonesian tourist: surprised to see Muslims, 'we need to be friends'

interactions.name: FI_HUMUS_RESPECT
interactions.who: 'Best humus in Israel', 60 years, 'we respect everybody'

interactions.name: FI_ARAB_CHRISTIAN_RACISM
interactions.who: Arab Christian, October 7: 'do you feel racism' — no, I want peace

interactions.name: FI_CROSS_SAFE_GAY
interactions.who: 'You are safe here to be gay, Arab, Christian, Muslim'

interactions.name: FI_POLISH_PRIEST
interactions.who: Priest from Poland: 'is it safe being a Christian in Israel'

interactions.name: FI_RELIGIOUS_JEW_EXPLAIN
interactions.who: 'I'm trying to learn from a religious Jew who supports...'

interactions.name: FI_SRI_LANKAN_WORKER
interactions.who: Sri Lankan worker: studied Israel in school, 'the people are the best', a gift

interactions.name: FI_BAKERY_MANAGER_25YRS
interactions.who: Bakery manager, 25 years, moved here a year ago, working next week

interactions.name: FI_ANGOLA_GAY_SAFE
interactions.who: From Angola: 'I feel safer being gay here than in Angola'

interactions.name: FI_JEW_HATE_EUROPE
interactions.who: 'As a Jew in Israel I get so much hate from Europe and America'

interactions.name: FI_RELIGIOUS_JEW_GARMENT
interactions.who: Tourist: first time seeing a religious Jew, 'similar to the hijab'

interactions.name: FI_ANAS_MUSLIM
interactions.who: Anas: Muslim, studied with Jewish and Christian kids, favorite part of Israel

interactions.name: FI_MEET_BADIK
interactions.who: Badik: what he wishes people knew about Israel

interactions.name: FI_INDONESIA_ZIONIST
interactions.who: Recently moved here: 'you're a Zionist' — I love the land of Israel

interactions.name: FI_INDONESIA_CHRISTIAN_SAFE
interactions.who: Indonesian Christian: 'no Jewish people in Indonesia', do you feel safe here

interactions.name: FI_MOROCCO_COUPLE
interactions.who: Muslim couple from Morocco: 'I'm Jewish, so happy to see you here', 'it's hard'

interactions.name: FI_INDONESIA_HOME
interactions.who: Indonesian visitor: 'this is your home', 'taught to hate Israel', welcome home

interactions.name: FI_CANADA_CHRISTIAN
interactions.who: From Canada: 'are you Jewish' — no, you're Christian, yes

interactions.name: FI_IRELAND_SURPRISED
interactions.who: From Ireland, 20 minutes in Jerusalem: 'what surprised you most' — the food

interactions.name: FI_IRAQ_JEWS_PERSECUTED
interactions.who: 'Your family's from Iraq — persecuted just for being Jews'

interactions.name: FI_ONE_WAY_TICKET
interactions.who: 'They were forced to leave — one way ticket, can never go back'

interactions.name: FI_CHINA_AMERICA_VISIT
interactions.who: Tourists from China / America here to visit

interactions.name: FI_FLOWER_SISTERS
interactions.who: Flowers: thought she was Jewish — she's Christian, her caretaker and sister, from Russia

interactions.name: FI_FLOWER_UGANDA
interactions.who: Flowers to a Christian woman from Uganda

interactions.name: FI_FLOWER_CRYING
interactions.who: Flowers: 'I saw you were sad, you were crying'

interactions.name: FI_FLOWER_MUSLIM
interactions.who: Flowers: 'are you Jewish' — no, I'm Muslim, wow

interactions.name: FI_FLOWER_LANDED
interactions.who: Flowers: 'I just landed, surprised to see Muslims' — 'can I have one rose for a stranger'
